cases.translation: the Israelites who came out of Egypt
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They rebelled against Moses and Aaron
cases.explain: The preposition «против» (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Земля разверзлась и поглотила их вместе с ___
cases.translation: The earth opened and swallowed them together with Korah
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The land must be divided among the clans
cases.explain: The preposition «между» (among/between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: let the land be distributed by lot
cases.explain: The preposition «по» (by/according to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu
cases.explain: The linking verb «был» (was) takes a predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: they will surely die in the wilderness
cases.explain: The preposition «в» indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: when they offered strange fire to the Lord
cases.explain: The verb «принесли» (brought/offered) takes the recipient in the dative case.

reading.question: What was the total number of Israelite men counted?
reading.explain: The text gives the total as 601,730 men.

reading.ru: У Целовхада, сына Хефера, не было сыновей, у него были только дочери, их звали Махла, Ноа, Хогла, Милка и Тирца.
reading.question: What did Zelophehad have instead of sons?
reading.explain: The text says Zelophehad had no sons, only daughters.

reading.question: Who was the father of Gilead?
reading.explain: The text says Machir was the father of Gilead.

reading.ru: Но Надав и Авиуд умерли, когда принесли Господу чуждый огонь.
reading.question: Why did Nadab and Abihu die?
reading.explain: The text says they died when they offered strange fire before the Lord.

reading.ru: Но сыновья Караха не погибли в тот день.
reading.question: What happened to the sons of Korah?
reading.explain: The text says the sons of Korah did not die.

reading.question: What was the name of Amram's wife?
reading.explain: The text says Amram's wife was named Jochebed.
